verification.summary: Node TAP: 6/6 tests passed. Local consistency CLI: 15/15 textual checks passed. The command only read project files and created/removed synthetic documentation fixtures under os.tmpdir().
verification.environment: Linux local workspace; Node.js v22.23.2; pnpm 10.33.0.

boundary_review.checker_behavior: Reads repository scripts, package.json and documents selected by docs/document-governance.json. It checks for required substrings/phrases and prints labels. It does not invoke either backup or restore shell script and performs no writes.
boundary_review.test_behavior: Each test copies source/docs to a mkdtemp fixture, invokes the local Node checker with fixtureRoot as cwd, mutates copied roadmap/backlog/manifest inputs, and removes the fixture in finally after successful setup.
boundary_review.external_effects: No database, network, credentials, backup storage, target, Docker, restore or rollback was used.

findings_and_limits.observation: The 15 checks prove required marker strings exist in current sources/docs. They do not prove shell control flow, command safety, actual backup integrity, or successful restoration; marker text in dead code/comments could satisfy substring checks.

Document paths from docs/document-governance.json are resolved against process.cwd() without repository-root containment checks. Current canonical paths are repository-local, but absolute or parent-relative manifest paths could make the checker read outside the checkout.

createFixture() allocates its temp directory and copies files before each test enters try/finally, so a setup/copy error can leave a partial temp directory. The test named “missing documentation manifest” writes an empty manifest rather than deleting the file. spawnSync has no timeout.

candidate_actions: Retain the explicit W3/REM-024 text linkage as a local documentation consistency check and keep its PASS separate from operational restore evidence.
Constrain resolved documentation paths to the checkout and make the fixture setup itself cleanup-safe; test an actually absent manifest if that is the intended case.
Keep real backup/restore, RPO/RTO and target certification gated under REM-024/M-14.
limitations: The test only validates selected required/missing textual markers; no shell scripts were executed.
No real backup/restore/rollback, checksum verification against a real archive, database, target, tenant/RLS recovery or RPO/RTO measurement occurred.
